label: Allele frequency spectrum
definition: Distribution of allele frequencies across segregating sites in population samples, used for demographic inference, neutrality tests, and population genetics simulation.

label: Base modification data
definition: Per-site scores or calls for DNA or RNA base modifications (5mC, 5hmC, m6A, pseudouridine) derived from nanopore sequencing or chemical conversion methods.

label: Basecalled sequence data
definition: Nucleotide sequence reads produced by basecalling raw signal data from nanopore or PacBio sequencers, including per-base quality scores and optionally modification probability arrays.

label: Biological embedding
definition: Dense vector representation of a biological sequence, structure, cell, or molecule learned by a neural language model, used for function prediction, similarity search, or generative modeling.

label: Cell barcode and UMI data
definition: Per-read tags comprising a cell barcode identifying the cell of origin and a UMI marking the captured molecule, used in single-cell sequencing workflows prior to count-matrix generation.

label: Cell barcode annotation
definition: Per-cell metadata table linking cell barcodes to cluster identifiers, cell type labels, QC metrics, and doublet status.

label: Cell embedding
definition: Low-dimensional coordinate representation of individual cells from dimensionality reduction of single-cell omics data, used for visualization and clustering.

label: Cell trajectory
definition: Ordered arrangement of cells along a developmental continuum, represented as pseudotime values or a branching lineage graph derived from single-cell omics data.

label: ChIP-seq data
definition: Sequencing reads from chromatin immunoprecipitation experiments, used to map genome-wide protein-DNA binding sites, histone modifications, or transcription factor occupancy.

label: ChIP-seq peak data
definition: Genomic intervals significantly enriched for ChIP-seq or CUT&RUN signal relative to background, annotated with coordinates, fold enrichment, and statistical scores.

label: Chromatin accessibility profile
definition: Genome-wide measurement of open chromatin regions from ATAC-seq or DNase-seq, representing accessible regulatory elements in a cell population or individual cell.

label: Chromatin contact matrix
definition: Pairwise genome-wide interaction frequencies between genomic loci from chromosome conformation capture experiments, stored as a binned symmetric matrix and used to detect TADs, loops, and compartments.

label: Chromatin domain data
definition: Genomic coordinates of TADs, loop anchors, compartment boundaries, and insulator elements inferred from chromatin contact matrices.

label: Copy number variation data
definition: Genome-segmented profile of DNA copy number states, annotating intervals with estimated copy number and log2 ratio derived from read depth or allele frequency analysis.

label: CRISPR screen read counts
definition: Guide-RNA-by-sample count matrix from a pooled CRISPR screen recording reads per guide RNA per sample or time point.

label: Deep mutational scanning data
definition: Fitness or functional scores for thousands of amino acid or nucleotide variants derived from a pooled mutagenesis and selection experiment.

label: DIA-MS spectral library
definition: Reference library of fragment ion spectra, precursor masses, and retention times used by DIA-MS tools to identify and quantify peptides.

label: DNA methylation data
definition: Base-resolution cytosine methylation measurements recording methylation fraction and coverage at each genomic position, from bisulfite sequencing or nanopore modification calling.

label: Drug sensitivity data
definition: Dose-response curves and sensitivity metrics (AUC, IC₅₀) from pharmacological perturbation experiments, used for pharmacogenomics modeling and drug repurposing.

label: Drug-target interaction data
definition: Quantitative binding affinity measurements between small molecules and molecular targets, used for virtual screening and drug-target interaction prediction.

label: Epigenomics data
definition: Genome-wide measurements of epigenetic marks or chromatin states, including protein-DNA binding, histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, and three-dimensional genome organization.

label: Flow cytometry data
definition: Per-event fluorescence intensity measurements across multiple channels from flow cytometry or FACS experiments, used for cell population identification.

label: Fluorescence microscopy image
definition: Multichannel fluorescence images of biological structures across spectral channels and z-planes, acquired by widefield, confocal, or super-resolution microscopy.

label: Functional metagenomics profile
definition: Abundance table of functional gene categories annotated from metagenomic reads, quantifying the metabolic and functional potential of a microbial community.

label: Genome assembly graph
definition: Graph-based representation of a genome assembly encoding sequence overlaps, contig connectivity, and alternative paths, typically stored in GFA format.

label: Genome variation graph
definition: Graph-based reference encoding population-level sequence variation as a sequence graph, enabling haplotype-aware read alignment and variant genotyping.

label: GWAS summary statistics
definition: Per-variant effect sizes, standard errors, p-values, and allele frequencies across genome-wide variants, used for polygenic scores, fine-mapping, and Mendelian randomization.

label: High-content screening data
definition: Plate-level fluorescence images from automated cell-based screening, combined with perturbation metadata, used for morphological profiling and phenotypic drug discovery.

label: Imaging-derived phenotype
definition: Quantitative features extracted from medical images by radiomics or deep learning, used in imaging-genetics studies and clinical prediction.

label: Linkage disequilibrium data
definition: Pairwise LD statistics (r², D') between genetic variants from population-scale genotypes, used in GWAS fine-mapping, pruning, and polygenic score development.

label: Long-read sequencing data
definition: Multi-kilobase sequencing reads from nanopore or PacBio platforms, enabling phasing, full-length isoform reconstruction, and base-modification detection.

label: Machine learning data
definition: Structured numerical data prepared as input to or produced as output from a machine learning model, encompassing embedding vectors, feature matrices, serialized model weights, and training labels.

label: Machine learning feature matrix
definition: Sample-by-feature numerical matrix of heterogeneous measurements prepared for supervised or unsupervised machine learning.

label: Mass cytometry data
definition: Per-cell measurements of 30-50 protein markers from CyTOF experiments, providing high-dimensional single-cell protein abundance profiles.

label: Metagenome-assembled genome
definition: Draft genome reconstructed by binning metagenomic contigs, representing a putative single organism from a microbial community.

label: Multi-omics dataset
definition: Paired measurements from two or more molecular assay types on matched samples or cells, enabling cross-modal integration and holistic analysis of molecular phenotypes.

label: Multiplex tissue image
definition: Highly multiplexed protein or RNA expression images of tissue sections at single-cell resolution, simultaneously visualizing 20-60 molecular markers.

label: Phased genotype data
definition: Variant calls with haplotype-resolved allele assignments linking alleles to paternal or maternal chromosomes, enabling haplotype-aware analyses.

label: Polygenic risk score
definition: Weighted sum of allelic dosages at genome-wide loci quantifying an individual's inherited genetic risk for a complex trait or disease.

label: Population structure data
definition: Ancestry proportions, principal components, or admixture fractions inferred from genome-wide variants, used to characterize population structure and correct for stratification.

label: Post-translational modification data
definition: Site-level quantification of protein post-translational modifications from enriched LC-MS/MS experiments.

label: Protein structure prediction
definition: Computationally predicted three-dimensional protein coordinates with per-residue confidence scores and predicted alignment error.

label: Proteomics quantification matrix
definition: Matrix of protein or peptide abundance values across samples from mass spectrometry-based proteomics.

label: RNA velocity data
definition: Paired count matrices of spliced and unspliced transcripts with velocity vectors predicting future gene expression state in each cell.

label: Sequencing reads
definition: Raw or processed reads produced by a high-throughput DNA or RNA sequencer, carrying per-base sequence and quality scores.

label: sgRNA library
definition: Designed set of guide RNA sequences with genomic target coordinates, used to map reads from pooled CRISPR screens or as input to guide design tools.

label: Short-read sequencing data
definition: High-throughput sequencing reads of 50-300 bp from short-read platforms, including paired-end reads from DNA-seq, RNA-seq, and related assays.

label: Single-cell ATAC-seq data
definition: Per-cell chromatin accessibility fragment files and peak-by-cell count matrices from single-cell ATAC-seq experiments.

label: Single-cell count matrix
definition: Sparse cells-by-features matrix of per-cell feature counts from single-cell sequencing, with associated barcode and feature metadata.

label: Single-cell omics data
definition: Molecular measurements made at the resolution of individual cells, encompassing single-cell transcriptomics, chromatin accessibility, surface proteomics, and multimodal omics data types.

label: Somatic variant data
definition: Tumor-specific somatic mutations (SNVs, indels, structural variants, copy number changes) identified by comparing tumor to normal sequencing.

label: Spatial transcriptomics data
definition: Gene expression count matrix paired with spatial coordinates for each measurement location in a tissue section, linking molecular profiles to histology.

label: Structural variant data
definition: Genomic rearrangements larger than ~50 bp, including deletions, duplications, inversions, translocations, and mobile element insertions.

label: Structured phenotype data
definition: Machine-readable coded clinical observations, diagnoses, and laboratory values used as input to genotype-phenotype association studies.

label: Survival data
definition: Time-to-event data with event indicator and elapsed time, used in survival analysis and Cox regression models.

label: Taxonomic profile
definition: Quantitative table of microbial taxonomic abundances from amplicon or shotgun metagenomic sequencing, recording relative or absolute abundances across taxonomy ranks.

label: Trained model
definition: Serialized weights and architecture of a trained machine learning model for biological data analysis, stored for inference or transfer learning.

label: Training labels
definition: Class labels or target values paired with a feature matrix or sequence dataset, defining the learning objective for supervised model training.

label: Tumor mutational burden
definition: Total somatic mutations per megabase in a tumor sample, used as a biomarker for immunotherapy response.

label: Variant call data
definition: Structured records of genetic variants (SNVs, indels) at genomic positions, including genotype calls, allele depths, and quality metrics, typically stored in VCF format.
